description: This file defines the final class InstallConfigurator in the Drupal core, responsible for managing the list of modules and themes to install, including their dependencies, for a Drupal recipe.

classes.name: InstallConfigurator
classes.description: A final class responsible for configuring the installation of modules and themes with their dependencies in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an InstallConfigurator instance, resolving dependencies, dependencies, and preparing sorted lists of modules and themes to install, throwing an exception if required extensions are missing.
